AGENDA
PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC
Members of the audience are invited to address the Commission at this time on items that are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Planning Commission is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

ACTION MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  JANUARY 15, 2019

Council Chambers  Tuesday
City Hall  January 15, 2019
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  6:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Present: Thomas, Criley, Chang & Walker
Also present: Contract Planners Jeffrey Graham & Aaron Lobliner, Planning Manager
Brianna Rindge, Assistant City Attorney John Cotti, Community Development & Public
Works Director Ken Rukavina

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC – None

CONSENT CALENDAR –

1.  M-1298-18; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for fencing exceeding the
  allowable height within the setback adjacent to the street at the single family residence
  located at 2765 Via Campesina. Lot 2, Block 1716, Tract 6885. This project is exempt
  from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner:  Sunil Adwani

  Actions: Comissioner Chang moved and Criley seconded to approve the application on
  consent (4-0 in favor, Lazzaro absent) with standard conditions and the following additional
  condition: 1) Due to existing conditions along the right-of-way, the City takes no exception
  to the construction of the non-standard walkway.

2.  G-1627-18; Consideration of a Grading Application at the single family residence located at
  2245 Via La Brea. Lot 17, Block 1635, Tract 7330. This project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Joseph Fournier Design, Inc.
  362 Termino Ave.
  Long Beach, CA 90814
  Owner:  Golnaz Eslami

Planning Commission  1
Action Minutes
January 15, 2019
   Actions: Comissioner Chang moved and Criley seconded to approve the application on
  consent (4-0 in favor, Lazzaro absent) with standard conditions and the following additional
  conditions: 1) New curb shall be constructed per City standards along the property frontage
  as approved by the City Engineer. 2) A new driveway approach shall be constructed per City
  standards as approved by the City Engineer. 3) Runoff from watershed tributary to the
  boundaries of the proposed project shall be intercepted and conveyed through the site to an
  approved drainage outlet/easement. 4) This project is considered Hillside Residential.
  Portions of the lot being graded/excavated exceed 25% grade; thus, the project shall comply
  with the City Ordinance and Municipal Code 13.08.060, Section C.

OLD BUSINESS

3.  NC-1644/G-1626/M-1293-18; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading &
  Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 2915 Via La Selva.
  Lot 5, Tract 11235. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Jeffrey Dahl
  1102 Main St
  Huntington Beach, CA 92648
  Owner:  Jeffrey & Ingrid Axtell

  Actions: Comissioner Walker moved and Criley seconded to approve the application (4-0 in
  favor, Lazzaro absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1)
  The existing curb along the frontage of the property shall be removed and constructed, per
  the Via Valmonte PV Stone curb standard plan ST-29. 2) Runoff from watershed tributary to
  the boundaries of the proposed project shall be intercepted and conveyed through the site. 3)
  Approval from the Urban Forester must be obtained for the location of the proposed
  driveway due to its proximity to an existing Eucalyptus tree in the City right of way. 4) The
  project creates, adds or replaces more than 10,000 square feet of impervious surface and;
  thus, the project shall comply with the City’s municipal NPDES permit and requirements set
  forth in Municipal Code 13.08.060, Section C. 5) The driveway and driveway approach on
  the public right-of-way shall be located 6 feet away from the closest Eucalyptus tree.

4.  NC-1645/CDP-114/G-1625/M-1290-18; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility,
  Coastal Development Permit, Grading & Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family
  residence located at 321 Rocky Point Road. Lot 3, Tract 17606. This project is exempt
  from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Joseph Spierer Architects, Inc.
  707 Torrance Blvd #100
  Redondo Beach, CA 90277
  Owner:  Kurt & Laura Robinson

  Speakers: Russ Barto, Richard Hadley, Mark McCaslin, Stacy Koehn, Jarvis Gatlin, Joseph
  Spierer, Kurt Robinson

Planning Commission  2
Action Minutes
January 15, 2019
   Actions: Comissioner Thomas moved and Chang seconded to approve the application (3-0
  in favor, Criley abstained, Lazzaro absent) with standard conditions and the following
  additional conditions: 1) The proposed nonstandard driveways are approved. 2) The project
  creates, adds or replaces more than 10,000 square feet of impervious surface and; thus, the
  project shall comply with the City’s municipal NPDES permit and requirements set forth in
  Municipal Code 13.08.060, Section C. 3) The maximum ridge height shall not exceed 19
  feet 10 inches from natural grade or existing grade, whichever is lower. 4) All trees shall be
  removed from the property, subject to approval from the Palos Verdes Homes Association.
  5) Any new vegetation grown shall not exceed the lower ridge height of 14 feet.

NEW BUSINESS

5.  NC-1622-18; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for a new single
  family residence located at 2640 Via Pacheco. Lot 6, Block 2317, Tract 6888. This project
  is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3,
  Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Joseph Fournier Design, Inc.
  362 Termino Ave.
  Long Beach, CA 90814
  Owner:  Jason Whitehead

  Speakers: Jonah Schnell

  Actions: Comissioner Walker moved and Criley seconded to approve the application (4-0 in
  favor, Lazzaro absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1)
  New curb shall be constructed per City standards along the property frontage as approved by
  the City Engineer. 2) All non-standard encroachments shall be removed from the right of
  way (brick walk, parkway, etc). 3) A new driveway shall be constructed per City standards
  as approved by City Engineer. 4) Approval from the Urban Forester must be obtained for the
  location of the proposed driveway due to its proximity to an existing tree in the City right-of-
  way.

6.  NC-1537R-18; Consideration of a revised Neighborhood Compatibility Application for an
  attached patio cover at the single family residence located at 3900 Via Palomino. Lot 1,
  Block 3, Tract 8043. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Jeffrey Dahl
  1102 Main St
  Huntington Beach, CA 92648
  Owner:  John Rogers

Continued to the February 19, 2019 meeting.

Planning Commission  3
Action Minutes
January 15, 2019
 7.  NC-1528R-18; Consideration of a revised Neighborhood Compatibility Application for
  revisions to walls previously approved at the single family residence located at 525 Via
  Almar. Lots 6 & 7, Block 1512, Tract 6886. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant
  to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner:  Steven & Helen Lundblad

Speakers: Michael McHale, Janine Nendick, Sarkis Kassardjian, John Nendick, Jerry Holman

Actions: Comissioner Chang moved and Criley seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor,
Lazzaro absent) with standard conditions.

ITEMS OF INFORMATION

8.  Minor Modifications – Reviewed & filed.

9.  Art Jury Meeting Schedule – Reviewed & filed.

ACTION MINUTES

10.  Meeting of December 18, 2018.

Actions: Commissioner Chang moved and Criley seconded to approve the minutes (3-0 in favor,
Walker abstained, Lazzaro absent) as written.

Adjourn to the Planning Commission meeting on Tuesday, February 19, 2019 at 6:30 PM

This Planning Commission meeting can be viewed via live-stream or on demand thereafter on
the City Website at www.pvestates.org

Adjourned at 9:04 p.m.

Planning Commission  4
Action Minutes
January 15, 2019
